title: 纹眉前常见问题：设计、恢复与补色
title_en: Brow design, healing and touch-ups: common questions
intro: 先问清楚设计、适用情况和护理，再决定是否操作。下面把容易混在一起的问题分开说明。
intro_en: Clarify design, suitability and aftercare before deciding. These questions separate issues that are often discussed as if they were the same thing.

sections.title: 眉形设计怎样考虑面部比例？
sections.title_en: How do facial proportions inform the design?
sections.description: 设计前，综合观察五官的立体度、量感和整体风格，以及颧骨、眉眶骨的高低、眉眼关系和原生眉毛的生长方向。在尊重原有骨骼结构的基础上，调整眉头、眉峰、眉尾的位置、弧度与整体轮廓，修饰面部视觉比例，协调颧骨与眉眼关系。
sections.description_en: Before designing, Lele considers facial depth, visual weight and character, the cheekbones and brow bone, the relationship between brows and eyes, and the direction of existing hair. The start, arch, tail and contour are shaped with respect for that structure to refine visual proportions and balance the cheekbones with the eye area.

sections.title: 是不是做得越浓越好？
sections.description: 在适合采用主线条与绒毛线组合的设计中，主线条先建立主要结构与毛流方向，突出眉部与眉眶骨之间的视觉立体关系；绒毛线再丰富疏密、深浅与虚实，让线条自然衔接。目标是有框架、有层次、有自然毛流，并与五官协调，不是把所有空隙填满或单纯加深。
sections.description_en: Where a combination of main and fine strokes is appropriate, main strokes establish structure and hair direction, bringing out the visual relationship between brows and brow bone. Fine strokes then vary density, tone and definition to connect the lines naturally. The aim is a framework with layers and natural hair flow that complements the features, not filling every gap or simply adding darkness.

sections.title: 留色与恢复怎么理解？
sections.title_en: How should I interpret healing and retention estimates?
sections.description: 手工留色常参考约1年，仪器约2–3年，都是经验参考。恢复因项目与个人状态而异，具体护理安排需结合本次项目、肤质和实际恢复情况确认。
sections.description_en: Around one year for manual work and two to three years for instrument work are experience-based retention estimates. Healing varies by service and person. The aftercare plan takes the treatment, skin and progress of healing into account.

sections.title: 设计、价格与补色
sections.description: 到店设计免费，约30–45分钟，不做也不收费。价格以大众点评当期门店信息为准，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: The design consultation is free and takes about 30–45 minutes, even if you decide not to proceed. Prices are available on the current Dianping listing. All services include free touch-ups within one year.

sections.title: 只做温柔自然的眉形吗？
sections.title_en: Is the design limited to soft, natural brows?
sections.description: 乐乐老师个人偏爱温柔、自然、原生态，审美带有东方美学的柔和与含蓄，但私人定制不局限于一种眉形。温柔自然、清冷精致或利落英气，都可以结合五官、骨相、个人气质与审美需求设计。
sections.description_en: Lele personally favours soft, natural brows and the restraint of Eastern aesthetics, but bespoke design is not limited to one style. Soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined brows can be tailored to the person’s features, bone structure, character and preferences.
